episodes.title: La llegada
episodes.summary: Tuka's missing uncle turns up, setting off a search for a mythical creature that will take Jodie and the group into uncharted, dangerous territory.

episodes.title: ¿Milagros?
episodes.summary: In the wake of Jodie's new local fame, Sarah shares further details about his father — and their fate. The kids put on a show featuring a shocking trick.

episodes.title: Despertar
episodes.summary: Jodie and Tuka are accused of blasphemy. Jodie urges Sarah to reveal any further secrets. Overwhelmed by his new identity, Jodie visits Father O'Higgins.

episodes.title: ¿Verdad o mentira?
episodes.summary: Sarah's pregnancy story is revealed. Jodie visits Principal Hernandez's home. A mysterious new man in town asks about the "Miracle Child."

episodes.title: Fe
episodes.summary: As Jodie embraces his role as the town healer, new followers display their devotion. Magda grapples with disappointment. Ángelo's anger intensifies.

episodes.title: Revelación
episodes.summary: Some residents of Santa Rosalía come together in mourning, while others unite in wrath. Will Jodie be able to calm the town's troubled waters?
